Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.29.0 adds the Portable Fortress as an independent SCIE-Port gameplay extension: a creative deploy item, a walk-through control core, an 11x13x9 integrated fortress entity rendered from the migrated DAE, segmented body collision, three hidden 0.36 threshold cells, batched deployment with rollback, four-direction rotation and save/load reconciliation. Recovery stays reserved and never removes anything. v0.28.1 Skywrath package ID and all vehicle, plant and industrial features are unchanged. Android 7723 rendering, traversal, save/reload and multiplayer remain pending device verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
